risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Project execution and revenue realization may be affected by administrative approvals and procedural delays, since the Company's business is concentrated in Government/PSU clients.
- Large infrastructure and e-Governance projects tie up working capital over extended collection cycles.
- Leads to pricing pressures and competitive bidding for Government contracts.
- Requires continuous investment in technology, innovation and skilled human resources to stay competitive.
- Could impact business operations and project timelines given the Company's reliance on Government-awarded contracts.
- Provisions requiring a Risk Management Committee under SEBI LODR are stated as not applicable to the Company; risk oversight instead rests with the Audit Committee.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Strengthen position as trusted technology partner in e-Governance, digital infrastructure, system integration and managed IT services, leveraging extensive experience executing large-scale Government projects.
- Continue to expand presence in the e-Governance and digital infrastructure space while focusing on operational excellence and timely project execution.
- Adapt to a shift from efficiency-driven to resilient-driven globalisation by diversifying supply chains and leveraging local strength and global opportunities.
